params.prompt:
STRICT RULE: Absolutely no music, only diegetic sounds; no one speaks.
Realism cinematic, real skin with pores and small marks, natural eyes, people and set lit only by this place's named sources: the afternoon sun high on the left, falling hard across the street and onto the faces, the shopfronts under their awnings in shade; dusty gold highlights, warm natural colour; fine dust hanging in the air.
Framed on the rule of thirds, with a light anamorphic lens character: softly oval out-of-focus highlights in the background, and a fine 35mm film grain.
Image reference 1 (location Madhopur bazaar): the Madhopur bazaar 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 2 (character Young Meera): Young Meera, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 3 (character Meera's mother): Meera's mother, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 4 (character Meera's father): Meera's father, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 5 (prop Paper bag): the Paper bag 100% as in the reference.
Continuity: Young Meera is clean and unchanged from the reference, with no stain, mark or damage; Meera's mother is clean and unchanged from the reference, with no stain, mark or damage; Meera's father is clean and unchanged from the reference, with no stain, mark or damage.
In frame only: Young Meera, Meera's mother, Meera's father and the market crowd. The street runs away from the lens, the shopfronts on the left, the wooden stalls on the right. Meera stands alone in the open middle of the street, near, the glass shopfront behind her; her mother and father stand across the road by the stalls, far, the width of the street between them. Eyelines never at the camera.
Opening: Meera standing in the middle of the street, her face tipping up; her mother standing by the stalls with the paper bag in her right hand, her father standing a step behind her; shoppers walking.
Nobody speaks in this clip: Meera, her mother, her father and the crowd never speak.
Meera is out to see what is crossing the sky; once the dust hides her parents she keeps her eyes on the place they stood, with persistence.
Meera's mother is out to catch Meera's eye across the road; once she has it she waves the bag higher, with zeal.
Pace: ordinary and bright until 8.9s, then one hard turn into dust and noise; every shot opens in motion.
S1 0.0-1.2s · full, from the near end of the street looking down it, standing eye level, static · market shoppers and vendors move between the stalls and the shopfronts, a bicycle rolls past with its bell going, dust in the sunlight; nobody we know in frame.
S2 1.2-2.6s · close, cut at the collarbones, from the front, slightly low, slow push-in · Meera in the middle of the street tips her face up to the sky, her look going up past the top edge of the frame; the glass shopfront soft behind her, shoppers passing far back.
S3 2.6-4.2s · full, a tilt up from the awning tops to the open sky, then static · a fireball with a white-orange tail crosses the sky from upper left to lower right trailing grey smoke, its roar rising at 3.0s; only sky and the awning tops in frame.
S4 4.2-5.4s · insert, the glass shopfront pane, eye level, static · the shopfront glass rattles in its frame at 4.3s, the sky's reflection shaking in it, a tin signboard buzzing above; only the glass and the painted signboard.
S5 5.4-7.2s · medium, from across the road on Meera's side, eye level, static · Meera's mother lifts the paper bag high in her right hand and waves it, her look passing right of the lens, level; Meera's father a step behind her on the left, hands at his sides; the wooden stalls behind them.
S6 7.2-8.8s · close, cut at the collarbones, three-quarter from the shopfront side, eye level, handheld · Meera's right hand rises beside her face to wave, her look passing left of the lens toward the stalls; shoppers soft behind her.
S7 8.8-10.2s · full, from the shopfront side looking across the road, eye level, static · a wall of pale dust rolls in from the right with a deep thud at 8.9s and swallows the stalls and the two figures by them; shoppers in the middle distance turn and run from it.
S8 10.2-11.6s · close, cut at the collarbones, from the front, slightly high, handheld · dust rolls over Meera from the right, her raised hand still up, her plaits lifting in the gust, her eyes on the place off left of the lens where the stalls stood; only dust and the shopfront behind her.
S9 11.6-13.0s · extreme_close, brows to lips, from the front, eye level, slow push-in · her eyes search the dust off left of the lens, her raised hand lowering out of the bottom of the frame, a loose shutter rattling somewhere behind her; only pale dust behind her.
All speech is in Hindi. Only the words inside double quotation marks are ever spoken aloud; every voice direction and every other word of this text stays silent.
No speech in S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6, S7, S8, S9.
Restrictions:
- No music of any kind: no score, no soundtrack, no background music, no melody, no drone, no pad, no sting, no swell.
- No added sound effects: no whoosh, no boom, no impact hit, no riser.
- Only diegetic sound: the characters' voices and the natural sounds of this place.
- Background people never copy the face or hair of any image reference; each referenced character appears once, as themselves.
- No words but the quoted lines, each only inside its own Audio window; outside them no one on screen speaks, whispers or mouths a word.
